restaurantName: Heng Qian Kou Huang Zhu Ying San Xian Mian
address: 11 Jiaotong West Road, Yueqing, Wenzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This family-run noodle shop, in business for over two decades, has won the hearts of many locals. The menu is concise: eponymous ‘san xian mian’ is noodles and three kinds of seafood served in a rich, umami-loaded seafood broth made fresh every morning. You can also opt for mud crab or mantis shrimps to go with the starch of your choice. In addition to rice or wheat noodles, sticky rice cake and shredded omelette are also great options.
pageTitle: Heng Qian Kou Huang Zhu Ying San Xian Mian
